name: finitevolx
description: Write finite-volume ocean and atmosphere models in JAX on finitevolX — Arakawa C-grids with ghost rings, raw stencils and difference / interpolation operators, WENO / TVD advection, land-sea masks with coastal stencil fallback, boundary conditions, diagnostics, forcing, spectral / CG / multigrid elliptic solvers and SSP time steppers — instead of hand-writing shifted slices, ghost-cell fills, Poisson solvers and Runge–Kutta loops.
